title: StreamEvent
description: The single normalized streaming event union emitted by every BrainProvider (ADR-0009). Callers never see provider-native chunk formats. A discriminated union on `type`.

breaking_changes: 1.1.0 (ADR-0039): ToolCallDelta.name now constrains to ToolSpec.name's pattern. A name a provider could previously stream that ToolSpec would have rejected is now unrepresentable; nothing in the repository produces one, so nothing migrates.
minor_changes: 1.1.0 (ADR-0039): Usage gains token_counts_estimated, identical to ProviderResponse.usage's field of the same name — a widening, every 1.0.0 instance stays valid. $defs.StopReason is now a $ref to the new $defs.StopReasonValues, which ProviderResponse.stop_reason also refs, so the two enums cannot drift apart.
compatibility.notes: Adding a variant is MINOR ONLY IF consumers are required to skip unknown `type` values — they are, and this is stated in the description of `type`. Changing the discriminator from `type` would be MAJOR and is not anticipated. `thinking_delta` is provisional: it exists so extended-reasoning providers have somewhere to put content, and consumers may discard it entirely.

type.description: Discriminator. CONSUMERS MUST SKIP UNKNOWN VALUES rather than failing — this is what allows a newer provider adapter to run against an older consumer during a rolling upgrade.

seq.description: Monotonic within a stream. Consumers reassemble deltas in seq order and MUST detect gaps.

provider.description: For telemetry and debugging ONLY. No caller may branch on this value — ADR-0009 requires branching on ProviderCapabilities instead. A static check enforces it.

properties_note: Variant payload properties are declared inside allOf above; this schema does not set additionalProperties:false because consumers must tolerate unknown fields per contracts/README.md.

call_id.description: Stable for the whole call. Correlates deltas, the AuditRecord, and the result.

index.description: Position in the batch when a provider emits parallel tool calls.

name.description: Present on the FIRST delta of a call. Absent on continuations. ADR-0039: constrained to the same pattern as ToolSpec.name, so a model asking for a malformed tool name is unrepresentable here rather than passed inward — the ADR-0023 case-folding hazard entering through a report of what the model asked for.

arguments_delta.description: Partial JSON text. Accumulate across deltas; parse ONLY after `complete` is true. Parsing early on a partial fragment is the classic streaming-tool-call bug.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Null where the provider is local and has no monetary cost. Feeds the ADR-0009 quota ceiling — an autonomous loop against a metered API needs a hard stop.

token_counts_estimated.description: ADR-0039. True when the provider lacks token_counting; the quota guard then applies a safety margin rather than trusting the number. Identical to ProviderResponse.usage's field of the same name — the ADR-0009 ceiling halts generation, so the guard reads THIS object, mid-stream, not the terminal one.

StopReason.$comment: ADR-0039 item 5. ProviderResponse.stop_reason refs StopReasonValues too, so the two enums cannot drift apart the way the identical-but-copied pair did before this version.

StopReasonValues.description: `cancelled` is emitted when a CancellationToken fires (ADR-0025) and is a normal outcome, not an error. `quota_exceeded` is the ADR-0009 ceiling halting generation.
